title: Style Guide
description: Global visual style configuration. Compiler injects these tokens into every generation request.

style_id.description: Immutable slug identifier for this style.

description.description: Full prose description of the visual style. For human reference.

prompt_tokens.description: Compiler inserts this string verbatim into every generation request prompt.

color_palette.description: Prose description of the color palette. Natural language only — models do not accept hex values.

forbidden_elements.description: Negative prompt tokens injected into every generation request. Must include text/symbol exclusions.

lighting_defaults.description: Default lighting instruction injected when no panel-level lighting is specified.
